title: Paid and moved in, then the real owner said the landlord did not own the house

steps.label: Listing seen
steps.detail: A house in the Houston area is listed for rent on Craigslist.

steps.label: Self-tour with a door code
steps.detail: The poster sends a code so the renter can go inside the house alone.

steps.label: Asked for rent and a deposit
steps.detail: The renter is asked for the first month's rent and a deposit before moving in.

steps.label: Paid $2,200
steps.detail: The renter pays $1,100 rent and a $1,100 deposit, part of it borrowed, and moves in.

steps.label: Found out
steps.detail: Four days later the company that owns the house says the poster did not own it, and the family is told to leave.

findings.text: The owner of record is a company, not the person you are talking to. Call the office on record yourself.
A door code shows access, not the right to rent. Anyone with the code can share it.
Rent and a deposit before a lease with the owner of record.
